verdict: The panel now follows the live runtime end to end: LAN entry derived from the pairing URL, readiness says 配对服务已就绪 while the daemon serves, no remoteAppBaseUrl warning, live status/expiry/actions, and the QR block rendered as visual evidence.

fixes.entry: internal/ui/remote/phone.go: when the transport is LAN and no remoteAppBaseUrl is set, ConnectURL is derived from the live pairing URL (scheme://host, fragment dropped), so 手机网页入口 shows http://127.0.0.1:3180 with no warning.
fixes.readiness: the readiness row uses i18n KeyRemotePhoneServiceReady (配对服务已就绪 / Pairing service ready) whenever the runtime is ready + listening + reachable (relay or LAN); the legacy "配置项齐全（未验证配对服务）" wording remains only for a config-only state, and no-runtime keeps 配置不完整 + the entry warning.
